meta.name: eol-stakeholder-sequence
meta.description: Plan who to talk to about a sunset, in what order, and what each conversation must cover. Use when an EOL decision is made and you want the landmines found before the announcement.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划下架前与各方沟通的先后顺序和要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果计划产品下架，需要在公告前梳理关键沟通对象与内容。
copy.tagline_en: Plan who to talk to about a sunset, in what order, and what to cover.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you plan a product sunset and need to map key conversations before the announcement.

howto.what: 根据要淘汰的产品和已知情者,规划与各相关方的会谈顺序。产出分步骤的沟通清单:每步列出需要对方提供什么、你需要给对方什么、要留意的危险信号,以及该步必须达成的产出(如批准或决定)。
howto.when: 在做出产品淘汰决定后、对外公布前,希望先找出潜在问题时触发。提供要淘汰的产品和已知情者即可;它也会询问影响范围和过往敏感情况。

say.text: 帮我安排淘汰旧报表模块前该和哪些人谈话的顺序。
say.note: 会返回排序后的会谈清单。

say.text: 我们要停掉一条硬件产品线,有8家经销商,先找谁谈?
say.note: 会按重型级别规划十站以上顺序。

say.text: 按法务、财务、销售的顺序规划这次EOL沟通,并注明每步要问什么。
say.note: 会要求确认级别后生成清单。

howto.what_en: Plans the order and content of stakeholder conversations for a product sunset. Produces a sequenced stop list: for each stop, what you need from them, what you owe them, red flags, and the output the conversation must produce.
howto.when_en: Triggers after an EOL decision is made, before the announcement, when you want landmines found. Provide the product being sunset and who already knows; it may ask about blast radius and past sensitivities.

say_en.text: Help me sequence who to talk to before sunsetting our legacy reporting module.
say_en.note: Returns an ordered list of conversations.

say_en.text: We're retiring a hardware line with 8 resellers. Who do I talk to first?
say_en.note: Plans a Level 3 sequence with 10+ stops.

say_en.text: Plan this EOL communication in Legal, Finance, Sales order, noting what to ask at each stop.
say_en.note: Asks to confirm level and builds the sequence.
